placements.title: malformed or incomplete input treated as recoverable, not fatal
placements.frame: when an expected structural field is missing or malformed, what fallback behavior must the system guarantee instead of failing outright?
placements.why: src-1 names the exact production failure being reproduced (a heading missing its id field) and src-2 states the required behavioral contract for that case (no crash; valid slug produced). Together these describe a recurring engineering theme — treating missing/malformed input as a case the system must degrade gracefully through, not fail on — that future envelopes testing other missing-field or malformed-input scenarios against the same derive-id (or sibling) pipelines would keep feeding. This passes the narrative grain test: it is not the fact of one test passing, but the standing design principle the test exists to enforce. No existing leaf or hub in the supplied graph structure (which is empty for this repo) covers it, so it is minted fresh under the newly-placed Architecture strata.
